narrative:
## Handover Summary — Integrated P&L

## Key Decisions
• FY2026 plan: EUR 15.6B net sales, EUR 905M EBIT (5.8%)
• Finance gate passed: within 3% of group ambition, EBIT above 5.5% floor
• Plant footprint benefit phased H2-weighted

## Risk Factors
• Rzeszów ramp slippage (under-absorption EUR 40–60M)
• China price competition in entry segments
• FX exposure on TRY and USD

## AI/ML Governance
• 6 agents generated 17 proposals across 6 phases
• Market and process intelligence consumed from 10 documents
• All forecast models within MAPE tolerance

signals.title: F&C Workshop Munich — UDP Evaluation
signals.excerpt: ~30 F&C stakeholders reviewed ACDOCA access, real-time P&L, Material Ledger and Cortex Analyst. Priority: replace BW E0P, keep SAC as planning frontend, single source for actuals.

signals.title: Manufacturing Footprint Programme
signals.excerpt: Two German sites closing; volume transferring to the new Rzeszów factory. Under-absorption during ramp-up is the largest cost risk in FY2026.
